description: This source file defines a partial class 'AdminPanel' for an ASP.NET web application. It contains event handler methods for UI controls such as buttons, facilitating navigation between different pages within the Online Examination System's admin panel.

classes.name: AdminPanel
classes.description: A partial class representing the admin panel webpage in the system.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; currently contains no logic.
